sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 10337 of 2023

Applicant :- Ashish Kumar Srivastava @ Ashish Srivastava
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, Civil Sectt. Lko.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ayodhya Prasad Mishra A.P. Mishra,Ayush Shukla,Jaylaxmi Upadhya

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.

1. Heard Sri Ayodhya Prasad Mishra, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Ambrish Verma, the learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the records.
2.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
703 of 2019, under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471, 504, 506 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Gomti Nagar, District Lucknow.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 29.06.2019 against ten persons including the applicant describing him as the owner of R.Sons Infraland Developers Pvt.
Ltd. stating that the informant had paid some amount to the aforesaid company for purchasing a plot of land but after some time it transpired that the company's office was closed and the amount paid by the informant was not refunded to him.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant is involved in as many as 118 cases of similar nature and he has been granted bail in 90 cases.

In para 10 and 11 of the affidavit it has been stated that the applicant is ready to settle the dispute after his release and he has given an undertaking that he will settle the dispute within six months from the date of his release from custody.
5. The learned A.G.A. has no objection in case the applicant is granted bail, subject to the condition of his fulfilling the undertaking given by him.

6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant is languishing in jail since 21.05.2019 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
7. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

(Subhash Vidyarthi, J.) Order Date :- 18.8.2023 Ram.
